subject: I had created my own function in R Studio, shiny app not working on deploying

messages.author: 316609b1eafc9442
messages.subject: I had created my own function in R Studio, shiny app not working on deploying
parts:
It's showing Error: could not find the function while deploying the shiny app on server, whereas it's working fine on the local panel. 
Function is defined by me.

messages.author: d6ebe55625e8e5a2
messages.subject: Re: I had created my own function in R Studio, shiny app not working on deploying
parts: You need to define the function in app.R (or globals.R if you're using the two-file layout), otherwise the server doesn't know which function you're talking about. A good way to test this is to restart your R session and then run the app. Then, you'll probably get the same error locally, since the function definition was somewhere in your local environment, but not in app.R (or other sourced files).
